crossRefs.note: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.
When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.
My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.
You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would like to reason the cause with you. Why does the way of…
You have planted them. Yes, they have taken root. They grow. Yes, they produce fruit. You are near in their mouth, and…
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

translations.web: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.
translations.bsb: They are free of the burdens others carry; they are not afflicted like other men.
translations.kjv: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
translations.asv: They are not in trouble as other men; Neither are they plagued like other men.
